Ni-SCSs that are mainly composed of the γ′ phase (L12, order face-centered cubic (fcc), Ni3Al based)
For example, the stress of pure Ni3Al system in the [112](111) shear direction reaches the maximum of 3.67 GPa at the strain of 0.2.

Moreover, there are strong d-d orbital hybridization among W, Re and the FNN atom Ni. This enhanced strong interaction can be considered as the main mechanism for the common strengthening of co-alloying elements.
These results are highly consistent with the DOS results, that is, the strong interaction between the alloy atoms with the common FNN Ni atoms of Re is the common strengthening mechanism.
The Ni3Al system doping with Re-W are the most beneficial for ISS, increasing by 20.7% in [112](111) direction.
